description: Source code for managing EV root CA metadata, including functions for adding, removing, and querying EV policy OIDs and root CA fingerprints within the Chromium project.

classes.name: EVRootCAMetadata
classes.description: Class managing EV root CA metadata, including adding, removing, and querying EV policy OIDs and root CA fingerprints.

methods.name: IsEVPolicyOID
methods.description: Checks if a given policy OID is recognized as an EV policy.

methods.name: HasEVPolicyOID
methods.description: Checks if a specific root CA fingerprint has a given EV policy OID.

methods.name: AddEVCA
methods.description: Adds a new EV CA with a specified fingerprint and policy OID.

methods.name: RemoveEVCA
methods.description: Removes an EV CA entry based on its fingerprint.
